proposition: Ibn Turka applies the same seven levels to the meaning of 'the Hour' in Q 54:1: level one takes bodily resurrection on trust; level two argues God can reassemble the atoms; level three holds only the spirit is judged and returns to its origin; level four holds the spirit is a light returning enhanced; level five holds all things return to the source through the perfect form of the Seal; level six holds the return is in the 29 letters; level seven is peculiar to the present time and works by jafr.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
